# Launch screen assets

Generated, not drawn by hand: the route glyph of `app/assets/icon/icon_tinted.svg`
at 240 pt, white for the light appearance and ink (`#0E1115`) for the dark one,
centred by `Base.lproj/LaunchScreen.storyboard` on the `LaunchBackground`
colour next door (`#3F7A00` light, `#C8F542` dark). Regenerate both with the
commands in `app/assets/icon/README.md`.
